description: This PHP source file defines the EducationDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It provides data access methods for Education entities, including save, retrieve by ID or name, list with filtering and pagination, delete, and check existence by name.

classes.name: EducationDao
classes.description: A data access object class responsible for CRUD and search operations related to Education entities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Persists an Education entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getEducationById
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingEducationIds
methods.description: Returns the list of existing Education IDs matching the provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getEducationByName
methods.description: Retrieves an Education entity by its name after trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getEducationList
methods.description: Returns a list of Education entities based on search filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getEducationListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a Paginator object for the Education list based on search filters.

methods.name: getEducationCount
methods.description: Counts the number of Education entities matching the search filters.

methods.name: deleteEducations
methods.description: Soft deletes Education entities with specified IDs.

methods.name: isExistingEducationName
methods.description: Checks if an Education with the given name already exists.
